items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman was one of them. 'Cause I met him, he sat at the table and drank

ctx.x: Maybe Mrs. Higginbotham can tell us something about that.

I can tell you an awful lot about that. I used to go to the Savoy Ballroom every Sunday in my life when I was a youngster. I didn't miss a Sunday. He and Chick Webb, Sidney Catlett, Walter Johnson, Sammy Williams - we had two bands at the Savoy Ballroom, you know. I was young...you all weren't even born then. We had two bands at the Savoy Ballroom. Jay was in the Chick Webb band and then there was another band which I can't remember. I even told them. I said, 'These white musicians are not up here for nothing.…
with me and everything. He wrote down everything these kids would write - would play.
